description: This is a test file for the React component 'GlobalTaskForm', utilizing testing-library and vitest for unit tests. It mocks context hooks, verifies rendering, input handling, tag addition/removal, suggestion display, form submission, and cancellation behavior.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Resets mocks and clears previous calls before each test.

methods.name: test
methods.description: A series of individual tests for the GlobalTaskForm component.
subtests: adds a tag when Enter key is pressed
adds a tag when comma key is pressed
removes a tag when remove button is clicked
adds a tag when suggestion is clicked
submits the form with task and tags
cancels the form when cancel button is clicked
disables submit button when task input is empty
